# sapintegrationsuite_partners (Data Source)

Lists every Partner ID (Pid) known to the tenant's Partner Directory. This is the primary brownfield discovery mechanism for Partner Directory content in this provider, since Partners has no resource of its own — see docs/guides/partner-directory.md. Follows SAP's server-driven paging to return the complete list, not just its first page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_partners" "all" {}

output "known_partner_ids" {
  value = data.sapintegrationsuite_partners.all.pids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `runtime_location_id` (String) Runtime location ID of the Edge Integration Cell to address, for example "myedge". Leave unset for the cloud runtime. SAP shows the ID in the Integration Suite monitoring URL after selecting the Edge Integration Cell as runtime ({"edge":{"runtimeLocationId":"myedge"}}). Requests then go to /location/<id>/api/v1 on the same tenant host.

### Read-Only

- `pids` (List of String) Every Partner ID known to the Partner Directory.
